literal.prompt: Какой аксессуар представляет собой широкую полосу ткани, которую носят на плечах, вокруг шеи или поверх головы?

literalGroups.primaryGround: MW scarf noun (1) defines it as a broad cloth band worn about the shoulders, around the neck, or over the head (L31-L45). The wording preserves those qualifiers; the four plausible fashion accessories are distinguished by body location/form: gloves cover the hand, neckties are narrow and tied in front, and belts are worn especially around the waist (MW L36/L44/L46).

literalGroups.primaryGround: The first sentence restates the exact scarf sense at MW L44. The contrast is supported by the MW necktie entry (narrow length worn about neck and tied in front, L36) and belt entry (flexible strip worn especially around waist, L44).

literalGroups.primaryGround: MW defines necktie as a narrow material length worn about the neck and tied in front; this is a concrete fact about the distractor.

literalGroups.literal: Ремень — гибкая полоса, которую носят преимущественно вокруг талии; он также может служить для переноски инструментов.
